players.product: AI-accelerated modeling and simulation software for drug development

quarterly_data.signal: Total revenue increased 8% to $24.3 million, above the top-line guidance given last quarter, with growth in both software and services. Software revenue increased 9% and represented 60% of total revenue while services revenue increased 8% and represented 40%. Adjusted EBITDA was $8.7 million, a 36% margin, and adjusted diluted EPS was $0.35.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $24.3M (+8%); software +9% (60% of revenue); services +8% (40%); adjusted EBITDA $8.7M (36% margin); adjusted diluted EPS $0.35

quarterly_data.signal: Discovery revenue, primarily ADMET Predictor, increased 19% for the quarter and 6% on a trailing-twelve-month basis, contributing 19% of software revenue. Development revenue, primarily GastroPlus and MonolixSuite, increased 12% for the quarter and 3% trailing twelve months at 78% of software revenue. Clinical operations revenue, primarily Pro-ficiency, declined 54% for the quarter and 58% trailing twelve months at 3% of software revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Discovery +19% (19% of software revenue); Development +12% (78%); Clinical operations -54% (3%)

quarterly_data.signal: Total gross margin was 66% versus 59% a year earlier, with software gross margin of 89% versus 81% and services gross margin of 33% versus 25%. Management attributed the software margin increase to higher development and discovery software revenue and lower software-related costs, largely reduced amortization following the impairment charge in the third quarter of fiscal 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: total gross margin 66% vs 59%; software 89% vs 81%; services 33% vs 25%

quarterly_data.signal: The company ended the quarter with 297 commercial clients, average revenue per client of $124,000 and a 91% renewal rate for the quarter; on a trailing-twelve-month basis average revenue per client was $148,000 and the renewal rate was 87%. Logo retention has been 100% for top 20 pharma and 90% for pharma generating over $1 billion in global revenue, with churn concentrated in smaller commercial pharma and pre-commercial biotech. The top 25 customers represent about 46% of software revenue with 100% logo retention and over 90% gross revenue retention.
quarterly_data.figure: 297 commercial clients; ARPU $124,000; renewal 91% (TTM ARPU $148,000, renewal 87%); top 25 customers ~46% of software revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Total services projects worked on during the quarter were 199 and ending backlog increased 18% to $24 million from $20.4 million last year. Development services, which include biosimulation services, increased 12% for the quarter at 77% of services revenue, while commercialization MedComm services declined 1% for the quarter but grew 66% on a trailing-twelve-month basis.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $24M (+18%) from $20.4M; 199 services projects; development services +12% (77% of services revenue)

quarterly_data.signal: Simulations Plus announced strategic collaboration programs with three large pharmaceutical companies to advance AI workflows across the drug development life cycle, using GastroPlus, MonolixSuite, ADMET Predictor and PKpluS. Participating companies integrate internally developed AI agents directly into model-informed drug development workflows for natural language interaction, automated data processing and coordination of simulations across multiple modeling engines. Management said there has already been a financial component to at least one relationship, that long-term commercial terms are still under discussion, and that AI is expected to become a contributor in fiscal year 2027 rather than fiscal 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 3 large-pharma AI collaboration programs across 4 platforms; AI monetization expected to contribute from fiscal 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal 2026 guidance was left relatively unchanged at total revenue of $79 million-$82 million, year-over-year growth of 0%-4%, software mix of 57%-62% and adjusted EBITDA margin of 26%-30%, with adjusted diluted EPS now $0.75-$0.85 reflecting an effective tax rate raised to 23%-25% from a previous 12%-14%. Third-quarter guidance is revenue of $20 million-$22 million, adjusted EBITDA margin of 27%-33% and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.20-$0.27. The company ended the quarter with $41.8 million in cash and short-term investments and no debt.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue $79M-$82M (0%-4% growth); adjusted EBITDA margin 26%-30%; adjusted EPS $0.75-$0.85; Q3 revenue $20M-$22M; cash $41.8M, no debt

connects_to.relationship: biosimulation software licensed by AI-native drug discovery companies

contracts.signal: Asked whether large AI companies are clients, management answered that among those in the circle of drug discovery, primarily AI entities, naming Recursion, DeepMind and BenevolentAI, coverage is not 100% but a good percentage of those companies are licensing some footprint of Simulations Plus software. Management said the opportunity to date has been primarily the ADMET Predictor discovery platform for property prediction, with GastroPlus, Monolix and PKpluS becoming candidates as those companies move programs into the clinic.
contracts.units: software licensing footprint; not quantified per company
